newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ports of Auckland wharf too weak for crane - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ports of Auckland wharf too weak for crane - paper.

text.p: An engineering blunder has left Ports of Auckland with an NZ$11 million crane on a wharf too weak to support it, the New Zealand Herald reported on Thursday.
The 810-tonne container crane was assembled on Bledisloe Wharf from sections imported from Germany. Tests have shown it is too heavy to run along rails on the water's edge.

A Ports spokeswoman said the crane would not be moved into place until the wharf was strengthened, but that it would be about two months before the crane was operational. The problem was not expected to cause significant disruption, she said.
